dataset: Existing complete 1610-image test-dev action cache, already viewed; not independent confirmation.
ownership: Calibration score-ordered one-to-one same-class IoU>=0.5 matching at confidence>=0.001.
strict_drift: Original owned GT was at least tied for best same-class IoU; selected coordinate lowers its IoU by >0.01, and another same-class GT has IoU>=0.5 and exceeds owned IoU by >0.01.
oracle: For diagnosis only, keep original coordinates on strict-drift rows; unchanged otherwise. Also report keeping every harmed owned row as a broader diagnostic.
decision: Both primary-arm conditions permit a small train-scene-held-out pilot only. No detector training or full official evaluation is authorized by this diagnostic alone. Regret is descriptive, not a substitute primary arm.
limits: Fixed-owner threshold recovery is not official AP/AR, not an upper bound on AP, not instance identity ground truth, and not a deployable result. Counts may miss drift on unowned detections.
budget: No detector inference, no training, no image decoding, no official evaluator. One full cached pass; no threshold search.
